entries.subject: DAMIT 12738: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-12738.txt. Model 12738, version 2024-04-09, pole (295°, 47°), period 14.31233 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Franco & Pilcher (2020), Spin-Shape Model for 50 Virginia
Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive models: Model 12739: pole (112°, 41°), period 14.3123 h. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 12739: pole (112°, 41°), 14.31233 h, version 2024-04-09. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.
